transform.sql: SELECT PI_LDS.DATETIME AS DATETIME, DISTINCT_PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME AS NVM_HOST_NICKNAME, CAST(SUM(PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS READ_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS WRITE_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE + PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS TOTAL_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_READ_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS RANDOM_READ_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.RANDOM_WRITE_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS RANDOM_WRITE_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_READ_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SEQUENTIAL_READ_IO_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDE.SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_IO_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_IO_RATE, SUM(PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT) AS READ_IO_COUNT, CASE SUM(PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT) END AS READ_IO_COUNT_ZERO_AS_NULL, SUM(PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT) AS WRITE_IO_COUNT, CASE SUM(PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT) END AS WRITE_IO_COUNT_ZERO_AS_NULL, CASE SUM(PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT + PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT + PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT) END AS TOTAL_IO_COUNT_ZERO_AS_NULL, SUM(PI_LDS.READ_HIT_IO_COUNT) AS READ_HIT_IO_COUNT, CAST(SUM(PI_LDS.READ_XFER_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS READ_XFER_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDS.WRITE_XFER_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS WRITE_XFER_RATE, CAST(SUM(PI_LDS.READ_XFER_RATE + PI_LDS.WRITE_XFER_RATE) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS TOTAL_XFER_RATE, SUM(PI_LDS.READ_MBYTES) AS READ_MBYTES, SUM(PI_LDS.WRITE_MBYTES) AS WRITE_MBYTES, MAX( CASE PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(READ_RESPONSE_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END) AS WORST_READ_RESPONSE_RATE, MAX( CASE PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END ) AS WORST_WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE, CASE CAST(SUM(READ_IO_COUNT) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(CAST(SUM(READ_MBYTES) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(READ_IO_COUNT) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS READ_XFER_PER_IO, CASE CAST(SUM(WRITE_IO_COUNT) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(CAST(SUM(WRITE_MBYTES) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(WRITE_IO_COUNT) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END AS WRITE_XFER_PER_IO FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME IS NOT NULL THEN PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME ELSE PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN END AS NVM_HOST_NICKNAME, PD_LDC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER FROM PD_LDC_LATEST JOIN PD_NNPC_LATEST ON PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID = PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID AND PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_SUBSYSTEM_ID = PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_SUBSYSTEM_ID JOIN PD_NHC_LATEST ON PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN = PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN ) AS DISTINCT_PD_NHC_LATEST JOIN PI_LDS ON DISTINCT_PD_NHC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER = PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN PI_LDE ON PI_LDS.DATETIME = PI_LDE.DATETIME AND PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER = PI_LDE.LDEV_NUMBER GROUP BY PI_LDS.DATETIME, DISTINCT_PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME;
